[27,63,64] Jalali/Wohlin snowballing - discussed as a complementary technique and explicitly not used ('This paper does not use snowballing').
[3,34] LDA and paragraph vectors - named only as future-work alternatives to tf-idf, not run.
[21,4] Fu et al. tuning / Borg TUNER - mentioned only as candidate future solutions for parameter selection.
notes: Empirical SE paper (EMSE, arXiv v5 2018): refactors three EBM/e-discovery active learners into 32 treatments, simulates on 4 SLR datasets; Scott-Knott used without any citation; the three SOTA baselines are both executed as comparison targets (refuted as 'best') and mined for components (supported).
